note: Read by tools/export_map_paths.py. Corrections to an input pressure before it is divided by the body modulus. Each entry is one correction: the pressure is multiplied by 1 / dt_s, for the records listed in applies_to and no others. Delete an entry to remove its correction; only the scaled input changes, and every unscaled value stays as stored. A literature record's scaled input is its pressure over its modulus, with no correction. Cable inputs are never corrected here.

scene_pressure.why: In the simulation scene the pressure constraint takes its value as an impulse over one time step, so the scene's 'Pa' is 1 / dt smaller than a physical pascal: 100 times at the scene's time step of 0.01 s. A clamped bar loaded once by gravity and once by the pressure constraint, at two time steps, shows it: the ratio of the two sags follows 0.01 / dt to within about 1.2%. That check is on a bar built with the same SOFA components, not on the actuator scenes themselves. Not yet ruled on by the project owner.
scene_pressure.dt_note: The scene's time step as committed. The sweep runners accept --dt and the records do not state the step each run used, so the factor rests on the scene default.
scene_pressure.chosen_by: Every record and draft record whose source.kind is simulation, whose provenance.scene is parametricGripper.py, and which has an input channel in Pa.
